mechanism.summary: Lower a complete, ordinary synchronous bytecode program into a compact immutable execution representation and run it on the existing Vm, frame, operand stack, call, completion, and property helpers so hot common operations avoid the large generic Op dispatch loop without creating a second semantic VM.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility depends only on the immutable bytecode instruction set and function execution mode. Every complete ordinary synchronous program composed entirely of implemented compact operations takes the same execution core regardless of source path, benchmark, function name, inputs, iteration count, or result. Any unsupported operation, generator, async function, direct eval, with, module-sensitive route, or exceptional feature declines before observable work to the existing Vm loop.
semantic_risks: preserving byte-for-byte instruction-pointer and jump targets while compact instructions share the existing Vm operand stack and local-slot authority

preserving JavaScript call argument order, receiver handling, direct-leaf routing, thrown-value identity, try/finally completion routing, and observable accessor or Proxy fallbacks through the existing helpers

keeping virtual-object lowering, numeric/control/typed loop plans, direct eval, with, generators, async functions, modules, class construction, and every unsupported operation on the existing execution route before observable work
ensuring compact-program caching is immutable and cannot retain per-invocation Values, property-cache state, dynamic bindings, or realm-specific mutable state
